summary.headline: Week ahead of target on both orders and revenue, and the quarter is running ahead, but the year is still behind at 98.9% of target.

points.what: Orders reached 1,069, or 120.0% of the weekly target, up 3.8% on last week.
points.so_what: The week cleared its orders target with room to spare, adding to the quarter's surplus in week 2 of 13.

points.what: Revenue was $72,778, or 112.9% of the weekly target, but down 4.2% week on week.
points.so_what: Revenue still beat its weekly target even as it fell from the prior week, so the softer week did not cost target attainment.

points.what: AOV fell 7.4% week on week to $79.71, outside its recent 8-week range.
points.so_what: This week's revenue came from more orders rather than bigger baskets.

points.what: Quarter-to-date revenue stands at 120.6% of the target to date, while year-to-date revenue is at 98.9% and behind target.
points.so_what: The quarter's surplus has not yet closed the year's shortfall, so the year remains the binding constraint.

points.what: Reaching the full-year target of $3,888,802 requires $85,077 of revenue a week, against a recent 8-week run-rate of $73,203.
points.so_what: The required pace sits above the current pace, so the full-year target is out of reach unless weekly revenue steps up.

points.what: AOV is 2.5% below the same week last year and fell outside its 8-week range this week, a change rated bad.
points.so_what: With order value below last year, revenue attainment depends on order volume staying ahead of target.

points.what: Revenue fell 4.2% week on week to $72,778 while orders rose, a move rated bad.
points.so_what: Revenue and orders moved in opposite directions, so next week's revenue target of $74,734 rests on order value as well as volume.

points.what: Orders came in at 120.0% of the weekly target and revenue at 112.9%, both ahead.
points.so_what: Both weekly targets were cleared, so the week widened rather than narrowed the quarter's position against target.

points.what: Quarter-to-date revenue of $148,777 is 120.6% of the target to date, with $839,219 still needed to reach the full quarter target.
points.so_what: Two weeks of surplus cover only a small part of the quarter, so the quarter is far from settled.

points.what: Year-to-date revenue is 98.9% of the target to date, a gap of $20,083, with 25 weeks left.
points.so_what: The year is behind even with the quarter ahead, so the remaining weeks carry the shortfall on top of their own targets.

points.what: EMEA orders rose 14.7% week on week and contributed 26 orders, 66.7% of the weekly change.
points.so_what: The week's order gain rests on EMEA rather than on the two largest regions, APAC and North America.

points.what: Organic orders rose 29.0% week on week and contributed 45 orders, 115.4% of the weekly change.
points.so_what: Organic more than covered the whole weekly increase, meaning gains there were partly offset by falls in other sources.

points.what: Display orders fell 36.2% week on week to 30, a contribution of -17 orders.
points.so_what: The smallest source pulled against the week's growth and held back the size of the orders beat.

points.what: Orders of 1,069 sit above the 8-week average of 991 and outside the recent 8-week range.
points.so_what: Volume running above its recent level is what carried revenue above target despite the lower order value.

points.what: The cancellation rate rose 0.3 pp week on week to 14.6%, a change rated bad, and remains 1.8 pp below last year.
points.so_what: At $852 of revenue per percentage point, this rise costs little this week but moves against the year-on-year improvement.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 22 Jun 2026 was 8.8%, a notable fall of 2.2 pp on the prior week.
points.so_what: Return behaviour is moving in a good direction and is not adding pressure to the year's revenue shortfall.

points.what: New customer signups were 232, up 4.0% week on week but 10.4% below the same week last year.
points.so_what: Signups are not growing alongside orders, which is the weaker side of an otherwise ahead-of-target week.

checks.name: 14-Day Return Rate names its mature week
anomaly flag acknowledged in the summary
sentences at most 30 words and 4 numbers
each slot only covers its allowed KPIs
